title: Add one carbon
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Cyanide can substitute for bromide at a primary carbon through its carbon end. The product is a nitrile with one more carbon than the starting alkyl bromide.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of bromoethane under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Bromoethane is treated with cyanide ion in a polar aprotic solvent. Which major organic product forms after workup? Cyanide can substitute for bromide at a primary carbon through its carbon end. The product is a nitrile with one more carbon than the starting alkyl bromide.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
